resources.string: Use your own identity for files made for you. Keys are encrypted on this device. Only enable this if you want to send the selected material to Cloud for decryption.

Identity imported. Enable the switch to use it.

The API creates a fresh P-256 key pair and returns both keys once. Its private key passes through the server. Protect it and share only the public key with the configuration creator. This does not copy the official Android Keystore.
Send the selected private key or file-bound agreement to Cloud to open this file.
The hardware private key is not exportable. This capture only opens the exact file imported in the official app.
